LESSON: IMITATING AND RESPONDING

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING
Topic 10.2: Imitating AND RESPONDING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Imitating AND RESPONDING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What do you hear?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify sources of sound in 5 lessons familiarization
2. Imitate sounds made in the environment for enjoyment.
3. Appreciate sounds produced in the environment the sounds are coming.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify sources of sound in 5 lessons familiarization
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify sources of sound in 5 lessons familiarization. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Imitate sounds made in the environment for enjoyment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to imitate sounds made in the environment for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate sounds produced in the environment the sounds are coming.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate sounds produced in the environment the sounds are coming. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Imitating AND RESPONDING.
2. Explain Imitating AND RESPONDING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: sing songs related to sources of in the environment sound in the environment
4. Show that you can: Identify sources of sound in 5 lessons familiarization
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Imitating AND RESPONDING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What do you hear?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing songs related to sources of in the environment sound in the environment

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Identify sources of sound in 5 lessons familiarization
2. Imitate sounds made in the environment for enjoyment.
3. Appreciate sounds produced in the environment the sounds are coming.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
